posts.topic: How to write a quote people can accept
posts.why: Teach. A very practical, money-related skill that the audience can use immediately.

tiktok.hook: How to write a quote people can actually accept.
beats:
Give one price,
not a range

Say what is included
and what is not

Say what happens
if the scope changes

And make the next step
one sentence
tiktok.vo: How to write a quote people can actually accept. Give one price, not a range, because a range means they will pick the bottom of it and then feel bad. Say what is included and what is not. Say what happens if the scope changes, in one line, so the change is not a fight later. And make the next step one sentence. If your client has to decide what to do next, they will decide later.
